programme.desc: S20 E91 — One Rule for One Hemingway deals with grief when tragedy strikes shortly after she reconciles with Shirley, Dunbar and Powell attend to a fight in a bar, and Gina is shocked when she sights a familiar face.
programme.title: The Bill

programme.desc: S20 E92 — Bust DS Hunter investigates Irene Radford's criminal plans by monitoring a meeting in prison with her son. Unfortunately, Hunter risks botching the surveillance after becoming distracted due to a prior relationship with a prison officer.
programme.title: The Bill

programme.desc: S20 E93 — Return of the Gang Queen Gina is taken prisoner by Irene Radford. As they talk, the pair find they have much in common, but Irene is clear that she is willing to shoot Gina. Meanwhile, the force gets to work trying to locate where Irene has taken Gina.
programme.title: The Bill

programme.desc: S20 E94 — Winter Blues DC Perkins assists DS Costa on a case involving a man suspected of being a paedophile. Unfortunately with Terry's mind on abuse within his own family, he may be more of a hindrance than a help.
programme.title: The Bill

programme.desc: S21 E1 — Cure the Sin Sheelagh realises that Lance is missing on the morning after his stag night and just hours before his marriage ceremony is due to take place. Worryingly, CCTV evidence from the pub shows him being kidnapped and forced into the back of a van.
programme.title: The Bill

programme.desc: S21 E2 — Double Jeopardy DS Ramani de Costa and DC Suzie Sim attempt to find out whether DC Terry Perkins' brother has been abusing his son. At St Hugh's Hospital, a woman pulls a knife on PC Yvonne Hemingway, PC Roger Valentine is gagged and handcuffed to a bed, and PC Honey Harman is left staring down the barrel of a gun. DI Neil Manson is still miffed about the arrival of Jo Masters, but DCI Meadows is prepared to give her the benefit of the doubt.
programme.title: The Bill

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Episode 3 A man is shot outside a Mosque and paramedics race to save his life. His legs are peppered with shotgun pellets, but the patient won't reveal the identity of the man who pulled the trigger.
programme.title: 999: Rescue Squad
